verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs document a simple two-option install (Docker or Pip) and self-hosting on consumer hardware, which would normally support a quick install-to-chat flow, but hands-on community reports contradict this: one user hit a hard Docker build failure (missing pyside6 dependency) and another reported the app grinding their machine to a halt, with others calling it 'still a bit buggy.' missing for 10: a verified minutes-to-chat walkthrough, resolution of the reported build failure, and independent confirmation the one-command install works cleanly today.
